description: Model-aware stage options for the Substage Detection dashboard. Silver layers use the authoritative copper/silver stage index; Sapphire uses the titanium substage-refined index it was placed on; Gold/Platinum use TD stages.
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT label, value, stage_start_ts, stage_end_ts, sample_count FROM (SELECT CAST(s.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS label, CAST(s.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value, s.stage_start_ts, s.stage_end_ts, s.sample_count FROM featurestore:nextier_copper_stage_index_v1 s WHERE CAST(:model AS TEXT) IN ('copper', 'copper_beta', 'substage_silver_aug18', 'substage_silver_aug27') AND s.well_name = :well_name UNION ALL SELECT CAST(t.stage_num_td AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS label, CAST(t.stage_num_td AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value, t.stage_start_ts, t.stage_end_ts, t.sample_count FROM featurestore:merged_td_stage_index_v1 t WHERE CAST(:model AS TEXT) NOT IN ('copper', 'copper_beta', 'substage_silver_aug18', 'substage_silver_aug27') AND CAST(:model AS TEXT) <> 'sapphire' AND t.name = :well_name UNION ALL SELECT CAST(p.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS label, CAST(p.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value, CAST(p.stage_start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS stage_start_ts, CAST(p.stage_end_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS stage_end_ts, CAST(0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS sample_count FROM featurestore:nextier_titanium_substage_index_sept3_v2 p WHERE CAST(:model AS TEXT) = 'sapphire' AND p.well_name = :well_name) options ORDER BY value) q
